summary: Itaú Unibanco Holding S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its quarterly Risk and Capital Management — Pillar 3 disclosure for the third quarter of 2026, signed by Investor Relations Officer Gustavo Lopes Rodrigues on November 3, 2026. The exhibit is a Basel-style prudential reporting package covering key metrics, risk-weighted assets, regulatory capital composition, leverage and liquidity ratios, credit and counterparty risk, and G-SIB indicators. No transaction, stake, price, premium or board recommendation is disclosed. This is routine periodic regulatory disclosure with no special-situations event; no deal terms to track.
